infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Manhunt shows you on the game map and tells the game when you leave the border.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Manhunt keeps tracking your position while your phone is locked in your pocket during a game.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Manhunt uses the camera to scan a runner's tag code.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Manhunt uses the microphone for the walkie-talkie.
